data.narrative:
Newcleo is a Series B nuclear energy company founded by Stefano Buono, Luciano Cinotti, and Elisabeth Rizzotti, having raised $755M+ to date. The nuclear energy sector comp universe includes 3 public peers (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private competitors, notably Valar Atomics, Helion, Oklo, X-Energy, and Nano Nuclear Energy.

The stage-progression method is the primary applicable valuation approach, using the $755M raised as a proxy for current fair value and applying a 1.9x multiplier typical of Series B-to-next-stage advancement. This yields an implied valuation of $1.4B. A peer-median approach could not be reliably applied due to insufficient comparable data points at the same stage and valuation tier within nuclear energy; while 6 same-sector peers exist, fewer than 3 met narrow filtering criteria, making cross-sector application inappropriate.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $1.2B to $1.6B, with a median point estimate of $1.4B. This range reflects the limited methodological input (one primary method) and the scarcity of tightly-comparable precedent transactions in the frontier nuclear subsector. Key uncertainties include technology risk (reactor design maturity and regulatory pathway clarity) and the timing and structure of Series C deployment capital, both of which remain material to validation of the upside scenario.
